description: Implements FORMULATION.md section 6's locked clustering method: agglomerative hierarchical clustering over a Jaccard tag-distance matrix, no genre anchor, generic tags excluded, empirically-derived distance-cut threshold.
signature: def cluster_tags(tags: pd.DataFrame, frame: pd.DataFrame, params: AnalysisParams) -> TagClusterResult
docstring:
Cluster tags into archetypes and assign games to them.

Args:
    tags: The run's tag rows for the candidate set, pre-filtered to votes >= params.min_tag_votes.
    frame: The enriched frame (used only to restrict tags to appids actually present in the candidate set, and available for any future archetype-level feature needs).
    params: AnalysisParams.tag_distance_threshold (possibly None, pre-freeze), clustering_linkage.

Returns:
    A TagClusterResult.

Algorithm:
    0. Drop every tag carried by more than params.generic_tag_max_share of the games in the candidate set (before the per-game cap), from both clustering and plurality-vote assignment. Share 1.0 disables this. The dropped tags are returned in TagClusterResult.excluded_generic_tags.
    1. distance = compute_jaccard_tag_distance(tags).
    2. Run scipy.cluster.hierarchy.linkage on the condensed form of `distance` with method=params.clustering_linkage (assumed 'average' per config.AnalysisParams' flagged judgment call).
    3. Determine the distance cut: if params.tag_distance_threshold is not None, use it VERBATIM (do not re-derive) -- this is the frozen, comparable-across-runs case. If it IS None (pre-freeze, e.g. run 1 itself), perform a run-local threshold search: scan the distinct merge-distances in the linkage's own distance column (ascending) and pick the SMALLEST distance that maximizes the number of clusters holding at least params.min_cluster_size games released within the trailing window W after plurality-vote assignment (the scoring rule; a frame without release_date_parsed counts every game), falling back to the maximum merge distance, source 'run_local_search_fallback_max', if no distance yields such a cluster). This run-local search's resulting threshold is what a subsequent scripts/freeze_empirical_parameters.py run would examine to decide the value to actually freeze (this function does not write parameters.toml itself; that remains the dedicated script's job per ADR-012).
    4. Assign each game to a cluster via plurality vote of its own tags' cluster memberships (see TagClusterResult's own spec for the tie rule).
    5. Label every cluster via label_cluster.
    6. Compute TagClusterResult.cluster_mode_shares: per cluster, the share of its assigned games carrying each of Singleplayer, Multiplayer and Co-op, from the tags before the generic-tag exclusion. Descriptive only.

Determinism: for a fixed (tags, frame, params) input, produces bit-identical output across repeated calls -- scipy's linkage/fcluster are deterministic given a fixed distance matrix and method, and this function introduces no randomness.
preconditions: tags is already filtered to votes >= params.min_tag_votes by the caller (run_analysis) or by this function itself if not already filtered -- MUST be filtered before compute_jaccard_tag_distance is called either way
postconditions: The returned TagClusterResult is deterministic for identical inputs (module invariant)
Every non-empty cluster (>=1 tag) gets a label
params_used['threshold_source'] correctly reflects whether the frozen value or the run-local search was used

edge_cases.input: Two obviously separated tag groups (e.g. {roguelike, permadeath, procedural} vs {visual-novel, dating-sim, story-rich}, disjoint game sets)
edge_cases.expected_behavior: recovers exactly those two clusters, per the module's own testing requirement

edge_cases.input: tags is empty after min_tag_votes filtering
edge_cases.expected_behavior: returns an empty TagClusterResult (no clusters, empty assignments) without raising

edge_cases.input: params.tag_distance_threshold is None and NO threshold in the run-local search satisfies the no cluster reaches min-size rule at any distinct merge distance (degenerate/tiny candidate set)
edge_cases.expected_behavior: falls back to the single coarsest cut (the maximum merge distance, i.e. one giant cluster) and records this fallback via a params_used['threshold_source'] value of 'run_local_search_fallback_max', with a warning event expected from the caller (run_analysis) -- this fallback path is this spec's own addition to handle a case FORMULATION.md's qualitative description does not cover

edge_cases.input: A single tag survives filtering (degenerate case)
edge_cases.expected_behavior: one cluster containing that tag; every tagged game assigned to it

unit_tests.name: test_deterministic_across_repeated_calls
unit_tests.description: Two calls with identical inputs produce identical TagClusterResult content, per the module's own testing requirement.

unit_tests.name: test_recovers_two_obviously_separated_groups
unit_tests.description: A synthetic set with two disjoint tag/game groups recovers exactly two clusters matching those groups, per the module's own testing requirement.
unit_tests.expected: 2 clusters, membership matching the synthetic groups exactly

unit_tests.name: test_frozen_threshold_used_verbatim
unit_tests.description: With params.tag_distance_threshold=0.4 set, the resulting flat clustering matches fcluster(..., t=0.4, criterion='distance') exactly, and params_used['threshold_source']=='frozen'.
unit_tests.expected: clustering matches the direct fcluster call at t=0.4

unit_tests.name: test_prefreeze_run_local_search_used_when_threshold_none
unit_tests.description: With params.tag_distance_threshold=None, params_used['threshold_source']=='run_local_search' and the resulting clusters satisfy the >=50%-at-min-size rule.
unit_tests.expected: threshold_source == 'run_local_search'; at least half of clusters have >= min_cluster_size tags

unit_tests.name: test_empty_tags_returns_empty_result
unit_tests.description: Zero tags after filtering returns an empty TagClusterResult.

unit_tests.name: test_tag_above_share_is_excluded_from_clusters
unit_tests.description: A tag on every game is listed in excluded_generic_tags and absent from every cluster when generic_tag_max_share=0.6.

unit_tests.name: test_exclusion_happens_before_per_game_cap
unit_tests.description: With max_tags_per_game=1, a generic top-ranked tag does not crowd out the specific tag.

unit_tests.name: test_picks_smallest_distance_maximizing_scorable_clusters
unit_tests.description: Two disjoint 5-game groups give threshold 0.0 and two 5-game clusters.

unit_tests.name: test_shares_use_tags_from_before_generic_exclusion
unit_tests.description: A tag excluded as generic still contributes to cluster_mode_shares.

unit_tests.name: test_out_of_window_games_force_a_coarser_cut
unit_tests.description: Games released outside the trailing window do not count toward min_cluster_size in the threshold search.
unit_tests.expected: threshold > 0.5 when games 3 and 6 are out of window

open_questions: See config.AnalysisParams' flagged judgment call: clustering_linkage and the exact run-local threshold-search procedure are this spec's own reasonable-default assumptions (average linkage; smallest cut clearing >=50% of clusters at min_cluster_size), not values FORMULATION.md itself locks numerically. Needs explicit user/architect confirmation before worker-coder treats this as authoritative, since a different linkage or search rule would produce different (non-reproducible-across-implementations) archetype boundaries for run 1.
